A Chicago riverfront landmark

The Nicholas J. Melas Centennial Fountain brings stepped cascades and a river-spanning water cannon to River Esplanade Park, at N McClurg Court and E River Drive on the north bank of the Chicago River. Dedicated in 1989, it celebrates the water district’s first 100 years.

When to see the water cannon

The water cannon is scheduled for 5 minutes at the top of each hour, 10 a.m. through 11 p.m., May 1–September 30, in Chicago time (America/Chicago). The countdown follows the published schedule, not live operating status. Weather and maintenance may interrupt the cannon.
